<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Rally:</strong> Indian benchmark indices surged, with the Sensex gaining over 780 points and the Nifty crossing 24,550, driven by a sharp 7% decline in crude oil prices and gains in IT, auto, and metal sectors.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>

  <li><strong>Investment Sentiment:</strong> Analysts are monitoring the potential impact of the global AI trade unwind and the possibility of renewed FII inflows to provide a positive outlook for Indian stocks throughout August.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
